summary.zh: 每台 Atlas 800T A2 服务器 8 × 910B（HCCS）、4 × 鲲鹏 920、8 × 200GE RoCE 口直出；每柜 8 台（64 NPU）；RoCE 叶脊 Clos 为参数面
summary.en: Atlas 800T A2 servers: 8 × 910B (HCCS), 4 × Kunpeng 920, 8 × 200GE RoCE ports direct; 8 servers (64 NPUs) per cabinet; RoCE leaf–spine Clos as the parameter plane

summary.zh: 48 节点 × (8 NPU + 4 CPU + 7 L1 UB 芯片)，12 计算柜 + 4 通信柜，7 子平面 × 16 片 L2；超节点之间为 RDMA 面（每 NPU 2 口）
summary.en: 48 nodes × (8 NPUs + 4 CPUs + 7 L1 UB chips), 12 compute + 4 communication cabinets, 7 sub-planes × 16 L2 chips; RDMA plane between supernodes (2 ports per NPU)

summary.zh: 产品页现行规格（真机 WAIC 2026 展示，交付数量未公布）：16 计算柜 + 4 灵衢互联柜、1,024 NPU；每计算柜 64 NPU（8 托盘 × 8）+ 16 颗鲲鹏 950；柜内 2D 全互联（72 片低阶 UB 交换），每 NPU 2 条 800G 光链路上联一层 100 Tb/s UB 交换（Clos）；8,192 NPU（128 + 32 柜）为路线图上限；超节点之间每 NPU 2 × 400G UBoE（两平面，假设）
summary.en: Product-page spec (machine shown at WAIC 2026, delivery volume undisclosed): 16 compute + 4 UB interconnect cabinets, 1,024 NPUs; 64 NPUs (8 trays × 8) + 16 Kunpeng 950 per compute cabinet; in-cabinet 2D full mesh (72 low-radix UB switches), 2 × 800G optical links per NPU up to one tier of 100 Tb/s UB switches (Clos); 8,192 NPUs (128 + 32 cabinets) is the roadmap maximum; 2 × 400G UBoE per NPU between SuperPoDs (two planes, assumed)

summary.zh: 标称 4,096 NPU；按单一媒体口径 56 计算柜 + 14 灵衢互联柜，每柜 72 NPU（9 刀片 × 8）+ 18 颗鲲鹏（合 4,032；“一组柜内交换刀片互联 72 昇腾 + 18 鲲鹏”按一柜理解，为推断）；柜内 LinkBlade、跨柜 LinkDevice（176 × 1.6 Tb/s）；NPO 光引擎 Hi-ONE（5,500 个替代 48,000 个 800G 模块）；超节点之间两层四平面 Clos 至 51.2 万 NPU
summary.en: Nominal 4,096 NPUs; from one media source 56 compute + 14 UB interconnect cabinets with 72 NPUs (9 blades × 8) + 18 Kunpeng per cabinet (4,032; the article says the in-cabinet switch blades interconnect 72 Ascend + 18 Kunpeng, read here as one cabinet, an inference); in-cabinet LinkBlade, cross-cabinet LinkDevices (176 × 1.6 Tb/s); NPO optics (5,500 Hi-ONE engines replacing 48,000 × 800G modules); two-tier, four-plane Clos between SuperPoDs to 512,000 NPUs
